scope: Compatibility and nominal-performance baseline for Cube closed loop. Native installed OGBench CubeMarkovOracle and CubePlanOracle, no added action/plan noise. Fixed single target for300 control steps15s, no automatic next-target reset when oracle.done. Privileged current object state and robot proprioception; no future simulator branch for policy input. Explicit seeded initial cube/goal/EEF variations, environment-owned RNG and global oracle RNG. This differs from default noisy multi-target data-collection wrapper and is reported as a fixed-target baseline variant. No smoothing, no learned policy claim, no finaltest.
